title: Preparedness for the AI Era Requires a Reserve of Critical Workers
summary_en: If governments or employers assume that permanent AI automation is right around the corner, vital training and career pipelines could collapse. We could find ourselves without enough people to perform work essential for our society to function.
title_cn: Preparedness for the AI Era Requires a Reserve of Critical Workers

title: Governing Augmentative Brain-Computer Interfaces
summary_en: This report examines how brain-computer interfaces could augment human capabilities, identifies signals of emerging augmentation, and assesses how governance frameworks can address the ethical and regulatory challenges these uses raise.
